evidence.quote: The degree programme is taught in English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 2,000 EUR
The following is valid for applicants from: all countries For the winter semester: 15 May - 15 July

notes: Tuition: the DAAD programme page states 2,000 EUR per semester for applicants from non-EU countries; TUM central pages state the general bachelor's range of 2,000 or 3,000 euros per semester, which is not programme-specific. Intake: deadline stated as "15 May - 15 July" without a year and for applicants from all countries, recorded as a recurring deadline; applicationChannel not extracted because no supplied page states the application route for this bachelor's programme (the VPD/uni-assist statement appears on a master's programme page).
